|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Kir Kanos (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V8-D-Kir_Kanos_(V)-2020-10-14-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V8-D-Kir_Kanos_(V)-original-2018-07-08-022435b.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V8-D-Kir_Kanos_(V)-2020-10-14-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V8-D-Kir_Kanos_(V)-2020-10-14-d5f24d6.gif]], 14 October 2020).
* '''Original''' ([[Kir Kanos (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-kirkanosv022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Kir Kanos”. Text: “When deployed, may take a Royal Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If in battle with an Imperial, once per game may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 14 October 2020<ref name="img-kirkanosvd5f24d6">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d5f24d6dd023e0aba39bc2f530e19465496ebf25 commit d5f24d6] (14 October 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Kir Kanos”. Text: “When deployed, may take a Royal Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, if present at a site with an Imperial, once per game may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt.”

'''What changed:''' this version is the errata-sheet slip (a different printing from the card image before it); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Kir Kanos”. Text: “When deployed, may take a Royal Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, if present at a site with an Imperial, once per game may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt.”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Kir Kanos (V) (Errata 3)]]): PC card image uploaded 14 October 2020<ref name="img-kirkanosvd802972">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d802972eb306f188a313c2c599694e7f18f35cae commit d802972] (14 October 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' “battle, if present at” → “battle, if with an Imperial and present at”; “at a site with an Imperial, once per” → “at a site, once per”; this version is the PC card image (the previous version was the errata-sheet slip). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Kir Kanos”. Text: “When deployed, may take a Royal Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, if with an Imperial and present at a site, once per game may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt.”
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Kir Kanos (V) (Errata 4)]]): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-kirkanosv6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (354×492 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Kir Kanos”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “When deployed, may take a Royal Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, if with an Imperial and present at a site, once per game may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt.”
